title: Work order totals and taxes still come from the saved line prices
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Use the staging site with the Tiered Pricing release (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too, once it exists); production is not needed.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with one range from $0.00 and Default on Markup % 50 and tier A on Markup % 20.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders.
  • Have a tax set up for this test at 5%, picked on customer A, with category A not tax exempt.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with two category A parts at a cost of $10.00 each and no labor.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click the Stats tab.
  3. Invoice work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The two parts sell at $12.00 each ($10.00 × 1.20 = $12.00).

Step 2:

  • Stats show parts of $24.00 ($12.00 + $12.00 = $24.00).

Step 3:

  • The invoice shows parts $24.00, tax $1.20 ($24.00 × 5% = $1.20) and a total of $25.20 ($24.00 + $1.20 = $25.20).
